svg.aria-label: First-difference a short time series Before → After: Subtract the previous observation to get $\Delta y_t = y_t - y_{t-1}$ Identity mapped: Each output uses the current and previous observation. The first observation has no earlier value. t1 → d2: Subtract 10 t2 → d2: $13 - 10 = 3$ t2 → d3: Subtract 13 t3 → d3: $15 - 13 = 2$ t3 → d4: Subtract 15 t4 → d4: $19 - 15 = 4$ Original observations Time: 1 to 4 Observed value: 0 to 20 $y$ (line): t1 t1 (1, 10); t2 t2 (2, 13); t3 t3 (3, 15); t4 t4 (4, 19) Consecutive differences Time: 1 to 4 Difference: 0 to 5 $\Delta y$ (line): d2 d2 (2, 3); d3 d3 (3, 2); d4 d4 (4, 4)
